day_focus: Be fully present with Maria and the kids today, and lock one clear plan for Boaz’s 15th tomorrow—Formation Binder ready, Daddy-Time real, no half-attention.
checkin: Son, Strategy Saturday isn’t for clearing every open loop—it’s for slowing down enough to lead well. Boaz turns fifteen tomorrow; the pages are live, but what he’ll remember is whether you showed up warm and steady, not hurried. Put the phone down for a stretch, look your people in the eye, and let the house feel your peace before the cake. Faith first, family second, output can wait its turn.
